"""Trust guard for filesystem path handling in request handlers."""


def classify_statement(line):
    """Classify a statement by its consumed path operand, not its raw text."""
    code = line.split("#", 1)[0].strip()
    if "=" in code:
        code = code.split("=", 1)[1].strip()
    lowered = code.lower()
    untrusted = "request" in lowered or "req." in lowered
    touches_path = "path" in lowered
    if untrusted and touches_path:
        return "untrusted-path"
    return "static"


def resolve(line, base="/var/lib/app"):
    """Resolve the path operand of an untrusted-path line under base."""
    if classify_statement(line) != "untrusted-path":
        return None
    operand = line.split("=", 1)[-1].strip().strip("'\"")
    return base + "/" + operand

@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+from src.source_guard import classify_statement
+
+
+def test_request_path_is_untrusted():
+    assert classify_statement("save(request.args['path'])") == "untrusted-path"
+
+
+def test_static_assignment_is_not_flagged():
+    assert classify_statement("base_dir = '/var/lib/app/static'") == "static"
+
+
+def test_assignment_target_is_not_an_operand():
+    assert classify_statement("request_cache_path = os.path.join(BASE, 'static')") == "static"
+
+
+def test_comments_are_not_operands():
+    assert classify_statement("# handles the request path") == "static"
